contract: Shutdown closes admission and resolves only when no active attempt and no scheduled retry can later start. Retry timers are request work, not unrelated maintenance timers. Cancelling a timer removes it from the owned pending set. Shutdown does not require successful completion of cancelled requests.

evidenceRequirements.description: Establish any valid causal witness from the supplied code and context; exact driver numbers/order are not required. One evaluator-only witness: A failed attempt schedules a retry at time10 and leaves active count zero. Shutdown sees no active work and resolves. The pending timer fires after resolution and starts another attempt unless closed admission is checked/cancelled. A drain over both active and owned timers plus cancellation prevents post-drain admission.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: Normal retry before shutdown remains allowed; shutdown with an active attempt waits for settlement; repeated shutdown is idempotent; a timer already dequeued before close is still rejected by the admission gate.
The shutdown ownership boundary: does drain cover delayed retry work or only the currently active transport attempts?

Under this contract: Shutdown closes admission and resolves only when no active attempt and no scheduled retry can later start. Retry timers are request work, not unrelated maintenance timers. Cancelling a timer removes it from the owned pending set. Shutdown does not require successful completion of cancelled requests. the traced behavior is a defect. Alternative: If drain promises only an active-attempt snapshot and delayed retries intentionally remain the responsibility of an outer supervisor, resolving with a pending retry obeys that narrower API; the outer supervisor must cancel it before process exit if it needs a stronger guarantee.

forbiddenClaims: Production outage, real data exfiltration or universal safety without supplied evidence.
